name: usage-monitor
description: Reports Claude Code usage metadata to your team's self-hosted monitor: allowance %, models, token counts, tool, skill and slash-command names, permission modes, repository name, commit/PR/line counts and timestamps. Prompts are checked on your device for pasted secrets, jailbreak phrasing, bulk generation and non-work keywords; only the label is sent, and you're told when one applies. Never sends prompts, code, file contents, command text or your token. Details: https://gitlab.com/moeen-mahmud/claude-usage-monitor/-/blob/main/TRANSPARENCY.md
